## GREEN (G)

Foundational List Constructor (Pair). Creates a closure that holds two values
`x` and `y`. When provided with a selector `s`, it applies `s` to `x` and `y`.
The building block for all linear and hierarchical data structures.

## BLUE (B)

```typescript
export const ATOM = () => (x: any) => (y: any) => (s: any) => s(x)(y);
```
